products.name: COS · COTTON-CHAMBRAY SHIRT
products.imageAlt: The gray long-sleeve shirt is being worn, featuring a spread collar and buttoned cuffs. Its front is partially unbuttoned, revealing a white undershirt.
products.imageNote: Complete selected-article US product media: 10 non-swatch images, including eight rendered gallery slides plus two descriptive packshot/detail assets. Excludes fabric swatch and recommendations.

images.alt: The gray long-sleeve shirt is being worn, featuring a spread collar and buttoned cuffs. Its front is partially unbuttoned, revealing a white undershirt.
A dark gray textured shirt is being presented, featuring a classic collar and long sleeves with buttoned cuffs. It is worn open over a white T-shirt, showing a relaxed fit.
The gray shirt is shown in side profile, featuring a classic collar, long sleeves with buttoned cuffs, and a relaxed fit, worn untucked over a white T-shirt.
A gray long-sleeve shirt is shown from the back, highlighting a classic collar, a back yoke, and two pleats below the yoke. It features buttoned cuffs and a curved hem.
A gray woven shirt is being worn, seen from a slight front-right angle, featuring a pointed collar and a stitched front placket. The top button is currently unfastened, revealing an open neckline.
A dark gray textured cotton chambray men's shirt is shown from the front, featuring a standard collar, concealed placket, long sleeves with cuffs, and a tailored curved hem, with a regular fit.
A dark gray chambray shirt features a pointed collar and a concealed placket on the front. A single dark button is visible at the top of the placket.

The gray cotton chambray shirt is shown from the front, featuring a classic point collar, a concealed button placket, and long sleeves with button cuffs. It is worn tucked into black trousers, highlighting its relaxed fit and smooth woven texture.
A dark gray cotton chambray shirt is shown from the front, featuring a standard collar, long sleeves with rolled cuffs, and a concealed placket.

The gray Cotton Chambray Shirt, shown from the front, is worn unbuttoned over a black T-shirt and features a pointed collar and slightly rolled-up cuffs. It is paired with dark green Pleated Relaxed-Fit Tapered Pants that fall in a wide, relaxed silhouette with front pleats and a slightly tapered hem.
